title: Hearty Korean Deodeok Root Wrap
description: A fermented and cheesy meal prep dish featuring deodeok root and ssam wrap, friendly to dairy free diets.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together gochujang, soy sauce, and rice vinegar.
Add the sliced deodeok root to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Spread the ssam wrap sheets on a flat surface.
Divide the marinated deodeok root among the ssam wrap sheets, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle shredded vegan cheese over the deodeok root.
Drizzle sesame oil over the cheese and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.
Fold the bottom edge of the ssam wrap over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap to form a tight cylinder.
Place the wraps on a baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes.
